fnol_text: My name is Viktor Sorensen and I live at 401 Oakridge Place, Ashland, OR 97541. You can reach me on (555) 969-5693 or viktor.sorensen@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 24 August 2026, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2023-00087. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home. I assume this is covered under my policy?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Sorensen on (555) 969-5693 to acknowledge the claim. Viktor confirmed the loss date as 24 August 2026.
Site visit to 401 Oakridge Place. Neighbour Sofia Okafor was present and confirmed the timeline.
Viktor sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
